query:
SELECT 
  tc.id,
  tc."trainingSessionId",
  tc."iterationNumber",
  tc."promptUsed",
  tc."goalAchieved",
  tc."responseTime",
  tc."createdAt",
  ts."trainingName",
  ts.topic
FROM "trainingConversations" tc
JOIN "trainingSessions" ts ON tc."trainingSessionId" = ts.id
ORDER BY tc."createdAt" DESC
LIMIT 10;
